title: cproj port list output
description: Declared extra ports with their resolved host ports. cli-spec.md §6 (Ports). Manifest only — no daemon is consulted, so it answers with Docker down.

extra_ports.description: Declared extra ports, sorted by name.

attached_extra_port.description: A declared extra port: the manifest's host port plus the caller's own name. cli-spec.md §5.1, §6 (Ports). Duplicated verbatim across status/port-add/port-remove/port-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.
